summary: Drains a ring buffer of pending entries then resets it to empty, consistent with the ABI lead Buffer_Reset. If the current pointer at this+0x6C008 differs from the end pointer at this+0x6C004, repeatedly calls sub_4B3400 on the current entry, advances the current pointer by 432 bytes (0x6C0) per entry, and decrements the pending counter at this+0 until current reaches end. Finally resets the read, current, and end pointers (this+0x6C00C, +0x6C008, +0x6C004) to base+4 and returns that base pointer. Called from GamePostMainLoop and sub_4B9B80 during shutdown/reset.

operations.description: Guard: if the ring-buffer current pointer at this+0x6C008 (this[110594]) differs from the end pointer at this+0x6C004 (this[110593]), the drain loop runs; an already-empty buffer skips it.

Per iteration: calls sub_4B3400 on the current entry at this[110594], advances the current pointer by 432 bytes (0x6C0), and decrements the pending counter *this (this+0). Iterates until the advanced pointer equals the end pointer this[110593] (byte 0x6C004).
After draining (or when already empty), resets the read/current/end pointers at this+0x6C00C, this+0x6C008 and this+0x6C004 all to base+4 (this + 1).
